sources.title: The Impact of Background Removal on Performance of Neural Networks for Fashion Image Classification and Segmentation
sources.coverage: Section III-D/Figure7 already discusses and illustrates pixel augmentations including Equalize with removed backgrounds. General incompatibility is not new.
sources.difference_to_test: This pilot uses identical processed foreground and background marginals with exhaustive cross-pairings, then tests fixed-model source-heldout loss; not simply removed versus original background.

sources.title: Local Patch AutoAugment with Multi-Agent Collaboration
sources.coverage: Searches regional augmentation policies with image context and includes Equalize. Local augmentation is not new.
sources.difference_to_test: No local policy learning is proposed here; a fixed-operator paired pixel attribution audit.

sources.title: ForAug: Mitigating Biases in Image Classification via Controlled Image Compositions
sources.coverage: Combines foreground-background composition with strong augmentations including RandAugment and controlled swap diagnostics.
sources.difference_to_test: Read sections do not separately report background-dependent Equalize LUT cross-pairing with exact processed-part marginal preservation. This is a bounded coverage observation, not a novelty proof.

sources.title: torchvision autoaugment implementation
sources.coverage: RandAugment and TrivialAugmentWide include Equalize with no magnitude argument; implementation dispatches to F.equalize.

search_boundary: 10 focused web queries + relevant sections of3 papers and official implementation; no claim of exhaustive coverage or no equivalent prior
